profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Arvest Bank
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with 14+ years of experience specializing in high-performance IBM i architectures and supply chain modernization. Proven leader in bridging legacy IBM i environments with modern cloud-native integrations. Expert at directing enterprise data modeling and SQL performance strategies to optimize mission-critical operations. Committed to driving developer productivity, technical governance, and architectural excellence.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer focused on enhancing Arvest's Core Banking Solution on the IBM i.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and delivered a high-throughput integration between legacy IBM i Supply Chain systems and Manhattan TMS, utilizing database triggers and cross-system SQL to keep Purchase Order processing latency under 10 minutes.

Partnered with Enterprise and Domain Architects to define and enforce integration standards, ensuring consistency and security across legacy-to-cloud modernization initiatives.

Directed the data modeling and SQL performance strategy, optimizing mission-critical batch windows and ensuring high-availability data access.
positions.insights: Software Architecture, Supply Chain Software and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Partnered with corporate leadership to translate complex supply chain objectives into high-level system designs, ensuring all technical solutions directly supported organizational goals.

Architected and deployed automated data extraction and self-service analytics tools, eliminating manual reporting workflows and reclaiming 75 hours per year to be used on other initiatives for business stakeholders.

Served as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for cross-platform SQL performance tuning, identifying and remediating bottlenecks to ensure optimal system stability during peak operational loads.

Led the transition to Git-based code reviews and usage of bitbucket code review workflows, increasing team deployment velocity and improving overall code maintainability across the IBM i ecosystem

Authored comprehensive technical architectural documentation, establishing clear reference standards for legacy system integration and enhancing knowledge transfer efficiency for the entire development team.
positions.insights: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), SQL Tuning and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as the Lead Engineer for all Purchasing-related deliverables in SupplyChain.

DB2 for I performance improvements and analysis using Access client Solutions(ACS).

Attended IBM's Lug conference yearly and gained additional insight to best practices to improve our dev ops in the RPG space.

Collaborated on the initial adoption of Git-based workflows, facilitating the first cross-team code review processes for the IBM I environment.

Trained Developers, BSA's, and other team members as needed to meet business needs.
positions.insights: Software Design, SQL DB2 and +4 skills

positions.title: Programmer Analyst I
positions.description:
Optimized and developed ETL processes from a COBOL mainframe to a Java Application Server.

Designed and developed efficient solutions as a Software Developer for a collections application using Java, Hibernate, and SQL.

Performed Java and Oracle SQL performance tuning and optimization with Hibernate, DynaTrace, Oracle AWR reports, and Heap and Thread dumps.
